February Kuwait Festival: A Month of Arab and ⁣Gulf Stars The february Kuwait Festival is set to be a spectacular⁢ event, ‌bringing together some of the most renowned arab and Gulf singing stars. This annual celebration promises an unforgettable experience for music lovers, featuring a‌ diverse lineup of artists from across the region.
A Star-Studded Lineup The festival will host​ 11 prominent Arab and Gulf stars,​ including:
Angham (Egypt) Khaled Al-Sheikh (bahrain) Nabil Shuail (Kuwait) Fahd Al-Kubaisi Matarif Al-Mutref musaed Al-Balushi Badr Nouri These artists will​ grace‍ the⁤ stage with their unique talents, creating a vibrant and eclectic ⁣musical experience.
Festival Activities The February Kuwait festival kicked off on February 6 and will conclude with a grand ceremony honoring Abdullah Al-Ruwaished. The ‍festival features ⁤performances by ⁢some of the largest‌ arab and‍ Gulf singing stars,such as Abadi Al-Jawhar and ⁤Ayed. Matref Al-mutref and Adam will also take⁤ the stage⁢ during the second ‌evening of​ the festival.
Highlights of the Festival february 13 : Ahmed Saad will perform,captivating the audience with his powerful vocals. February 14 : Mohamed Abdo, known as the “Arab Artist,” will present an⁢ evening of Taraby, a traditional form of Arabic music. February 19 : Majed will perform, ⁢showcasing his new songs, including‍ “The Air.” February 20 : Nabil Shuail will share the stage with Asil Abu Bakr and Omaima Talib‌ for a distinguished⁣ artistic evening. With a star-studded lineup and a variety of performances, this festival promises to be an unforgettable experience for all attendees.For more information on the festival and its activities, visit the official website .
